arguments.summary: Customer Marcus Thompson (user_id: mt35a7c9d2) verified (DOB 03/15/1990, phone 206-555-3842, email marcus.thompson@techdev.io). Customer unfroze Blue Account card in app; believes declines (CODE 05) are due to a velocity block after multiple purchases yesterday. Customer requests that the velocity block be cleared so they can retry a payment of ~$85 at a Seattle restaurant. Attempted diagnostics in-chat; agent cannot directly clear velocity blocks with available tools and requests transfer to security/operations to clear the block and restore card functionality.

proposals.text: You're all set — I've transferred you to our security/operations team and included the summary and verification. A human agent will assist you shortly to clear the velocity block so you can retry your restaurant payment. Is there anything else I can do while you wait?
